scope_excerpt.text: This PCR covers complete manufacture of bare uninstalled flat cellulose-fibre cement board from purchased Portland cement, prepared cellulose pulp, quartz-rich sand and every actually used separate supply, through first quality release, with subsequent observed packing/storage/handling/dispatch recorded as a separate service account. The selected route is pulp dispersion/refining and actual sand preparation → dosing/slurry mixing → Hatschek sieve/felt/format-roll forming and dewatering → green cutting/stacking/pressing → documented precuring → steam autoclaving → cooling/de-stacking → actual drying/final trim and tests → first release. It is a transparent technical synthesis of manufacturer and certification evidence, not an asserted same-SKU, same-plant recipe or contemporary order. bba-superflex-2019; uac-fibre-cement-2024; iibcc-cutting-2010; swisspearl-manufacture.

Cellulose pulp means discrete prepared plant fibres, not wood chips or wood wool. Cellulose is the only reinforcing fibre in this selected method; a real polymer retention aid is a separately supplied preparation, not automatically a reinforcing fibre. Exclude asbestos, PVA/glass/basalt or other reinforcement, gypsum matrices, resin/wood-particle agglomerates, corrugated/moulded roofing, patterned or coated boards, externally faced/laminated boards, composites with dissimilar layers and installed roof/wall systems. Those require a distinct applicability decision. Same-formulation thin-layer accumulation inherent in Hatschek forming remains included; it is not the excluded dissimilar-layer composite. Cement manufacture is upstream, not whole-board manufacture. No formulation, fibre share, water/cement ratio, curing temperature/time, strength, density, operating recipe, installation test threshold or service life is prescribed. The declared unit is manufacturing supply, not proven installed performance.

本PCR覆盖从外购硅酸盐水泥、已制备纤维素纸浆、富石英硅砂及每种实际使用的单独供货开始，制造未安装裸纤维素纤维水泥平板至首次质量放行的完整过程；后续观测到的包装、储存、搬运、发运另列服务账。选定路线为纸浆分散精磨及实际硅砂制备→计量浆料配混→Hatschek圆网/毛毯/成形辊成形脱水→湿切、堆垛压制→有记录预养→蒸汽蒸压→冷却脱垛→真实干燥、终修边和试验→首次放行。这是制造商及认证证据的透明技术综合，不宣称同SKU、同工厂配方或当代订单。bba-superflex-2019; uac-fibre-cement-2024; iibcc-cutting-2010; swisspearl-manufacture。

纤维素纸浆指已制备的分散植物纤维，不是木屑或木丝。本选定方法仅以纤维素为增强纤维；真实聚合物助留剂为单独供货制剂，不自动属于增强纤维。排除石棉、PVA、玻璃、玄武岩或其他增强纤维、石膏基体、树脂木粒胶结物、波形模制屋面、压纹或涂覆板、外覆面或另加层压面层的板、由不同材料层组成的复合板及已安装屋面墙系统，须另作适用性决定。Hatschek成形固有的同配方薄层叠积仍在范围内，不属于上述排除的异材层复合结构。水泥制造属于上游，不是整板制造。不规定配方、纤维份额、水灰比、养护温时、强度、密度、制造操作配方、安装试验阈值或寿命。声明单位表示制造供货，不证明安装性能。

en-US.text: | heat_balance | heat_in | At the declared supplier interface, determine net thermal service from separately integrated delivered hot-water mass times supply specific enthalpy minus separately integrated returned-water mass times return specific enthalpy, in consistent units. Reconcile every actual other carrier-water inlet/outlet, leakage, loss and thermal storage change on that same boundary and time interval before calling the result delivered net heat; unresolved carrier balance or enthalpy leaves the result unresolved. The shortcut delivered mass × (supply enthalpy - return enthalpy) is valid only when equal delivered and returned masses are demonstrated on that boundary/interval. Divide the supported net heat by B once. Metered electricity MJ = kWh × 3.6; no duplicate purchased heat for electric heating. | cp_heat; cp_utilities; cp_product ; actual_supply_mass; actual_return_mass; actual_carrier_state; other_mass_heat_legs; thermal_stock_change | MJ per kg reference flow | epa-wood-preserving-1999 |

zh-CN.text: | heat_balance | heat_in | 在声明供方接口，用分别积分的交付热水质量乘供水比焓，减分别积分的实际回水质量乘回水比焓，以一致单位确定净热服务。称为交付净热前，须在同一边界及时间区间核对所有其他真实载水进出、泄漏、损失与热储量变化；载水平衡或焓未确定时结果保持未决。仅已证明该边界和区间供回质量相等时，才可用交付质量×（供水焓-回水焓）简式。将有依据净热仅除以B一次。电表电能MJ=kWh×3.6；电加热不得重复记外购热。 | cp_heat; cp_utilities; cp_product ; actual_supply_mass; actual_return_mass; actual_carrier_state; other_mass_heat_legs; thermal_stock_change | MJ 每 kg 参考流 | epa-wood-preserving-1999 |

en-US.text: | heat_balance | electricity; boiler | Electric MJ = kWh × 3.6; fuel input energy = measured chip mass × same-state measured heating value. For each declared thermal boundary, integrate each actual supplied steam mass × its inlet specific enthalpy and subtract each independently measured return mass × its actual return specific enthalpy. Reconcile make-up, unreturned condensate, leakage/blowdown, other carrier legs, boiler/distribution losses and thermal stock changes on that boundary/time basis before attributing useful heat. A missing mass or state leaves thermal closure unresolved. Use steam mass × (inlet enthalpy - return enthalpy) only for proven equal-mass matched supply/return legs. External electricity is not also an internal heat purchase. | cp_energy ; actual_supply_mass; actual_return_mass; actual_carrier_state; other_mass_heat_legs; thermal_stock_change | gross site fuel/power/thermal ledger and causal attribution | epa-wood-boiler-2022 |

zh-CN.text: | heat_balance | electricity; boiler | 电力MJ=kWh×3.6；燃料输入能量=实测木片质量×同状态实测热值。对每个声明热边界，积分每条实际供汽质量×其入口比焓，并减去各独立实测回流质量×其实际回流比焓。归属有效热之前，须在同一边界时间基准核对补水、未返回凝结水、泄漏排污、其他载水腿、锅炉/配热损失与热储量变化；质量或状态缺失时热闭合保持未决。仅供回腿已证明同边界同期间质量匹配时，才用蒸汽质量×（入口焓-回流焓）简式。外部电力不再作为内部热采购。 | cp_energy ; actual_supply_mass; actual_return_mass; actual_carrier_state; other_mass_heat_legs; thermal_stock_change | 场址燃料/电力/热量实物总账及因果归属 | epa-wood-boiler-2022 |

| normalize_campaign | all inventory rows | After shipment_cohort_vectors is complete, a_i = Q_i / V_net for the selected first-dispatch cohort. Here Q_i is the compatible extensive physical-provenance numerator traced to those panels, including prior-period history; it is not an unmatched current-period receipt, meter total or purchase. Keep the separately attributed burden numerator A_i and its A_i/V_net model view distinct from gross physical ledgers; never shrink actual co-product/waste movements by burden shares. V_net remains the measured accepted net geometric panel volume in m3 at the existing shipment gate, with paired same-state P_net; finished_panel is 1 m3. Preserve all original records, closing carrying vectors and actual losses/services. No normalized result when V_net is zero or unknown, or required history is missing; a zero numerator is used only when evidenced for an otherwise valid cohort. | Q_i; V_net; P_net; cp_product; respective row protocol ; shipment_cohort_vectors; inherited_physical_and_burden_vectors; A_i | a_i | corrim-western-plywood-2025 |

| shipment_cohort_vectors | all inventory rows | Keep the existing accepted factory-shipment gate. V_net is measured net geometric volume of panels making their unique first external dispatch in the selected delivery cohort and recorded delivery state; newly first-dispatched opening FG is included with its inherited history, but unshipped closing FG and previously dispatched returns/re-dispatch never create additional manufacturing V_net. Identify each panel/batch, production cohort, first-release and first-dispatch events, original returned-item outward record and actual state. Carry complete exchange-by-exchange extensive physical-provenance and separately attributed burden/provider vectors through raw stocks, all WIP stages and unshipped FG, including prior periods and actual failed/startup/rework activity assigned to its production cohort. For each compatible vector reconcile opening history + actual new activity + evidenced incoming transfers = vectors assigned to the selected first-dispatched panels + closing raw/WIP/unshipped-FG history + separately justified other-cohort/function transfers. Released but unshipped FG remains a carrying stock for this shipment-gate method; ordinary rejects, samples, waste or sales do not automatically export their causing/treatment burdens. Correct raw receipts for stocks once only. Allocation/splitting requires actual cohort/configuration evidence, never an automatic current-shipment fraction or a missing-history zero. Preserve source process, carrier, unit, state, provider and earlier allocation so inherited upstream loads are neither relabelled direct factory emissions nor added to a provider already owning them. Keep full current-period physical gate quantities separately from cohort attribution. Same-item returns retain their original manufacturing cohort and first-dispatch history; subsequent storage, handling, repair/re-dispatch and actual failed/unauthorized work are separately measured incremental services with their explicitly declared original cohort/service basis, never a second manufacturing output. Any actual missing return/service/waste exchange requires its concrete card and protocol before dataset completeness. If V_net is zero or unknown, retain absolute operations and all unassigned vectors without division or omission; do not fabricate production. An incomplete history or unresolved cohort assignment prevents a complete normalized result. | cp_product; respective row protocol; original_cohort_records; opening_history; closing_history; actual_activity; traceable_transfers; original_dispatch_returns; service_records | compatible_shipment_numerators_and_preserved_stock_vectors | wood-handbook-2021; corrim-western-plywood-2025 |

| stage_heat | natural_gas; wood_fuel; electricity | Fuel input energy = fuel quantity × measured heating value at the same state. At each stage boundary integrate supplied steam mass × inlet specific enthalpy separately from returned condensate mass × actual return specific enthalpy. Reconcile each actual make-up/unreturned-condensate/blowdown/leak leg, other heat exports, losses and thermal storage on the same boundary and interval before determining stage useful heat; unknown mass or enthalpy prevents a complete result. The single steam-mass × enthalpy-difference shortcut requires demonstrated equal supply/return masses. Heat remains an internal balance/allocation record; count external fuels/electricity and emissions once. | cp_energy ; actual_supply_mass; actual_return_mass; actual_carrier_state; other_mass_heat_legs; thermal_stock_change | stage thermal and fuel balance | epa-plywood-2002; epa-wood-boiler-2022 |

| validate_denominator | all inventory rows | Reference 1 m3, all denominators and aggregation/calculation use the same measured accepted V_net at delivery state. Exactly one finished_panel reference output; no duplicate intermediate reference UUID. Check actual dimensions/hole convention and paired P_net/rho_state; exclude packaging/stack air/nominal dimensions/rejects. No invented density or per-panel weight. | corrim-western-plywood-2025; wood-handbook-2021 |

mathematical_readback.check: Each repair now requires separately measured/integrated supply and return mass*actual specific enthalpy, complete same-boundary carrier/other-leg/loss/storage reconciliation before net/useful heat, and uses one-mass difference only after equal supply/return mass is proved.

counterexamples.result: Current rule retains26MJ only as measured-leg difference pending states/otherlegs/loss/storage; it no longer asserts25MJ or calls26MJ useful heat without closure.
For proved same-boundary/time/enthalpy-datum matched legs the shortcut and separate integrations agree.
